curricula.name: Beast Academy
curricula.subject: Math
curricula.favoritePart: The graphic-novel style guides make highly advanced concepts fun and approachable.
curricula.description: A highly rigorous, comic-book styled math curriculum designed to develop deep problem-solving skills for grades 1-5.

curricula.name: Saxon Math 5/4
curricula.subject: Math
curricula.favoritePart: Incremental lessons ensure student retention through constant practice.
curricula.description: An incremental, spiral-based math program focusing on fundamentals, constant review, and structured lessons.

curricula.name: Mystery Science
curricula.subject: Science
curricula.favoritePart: Open-and-go video lessons and simple hands-on worksheets make prep nearly zero.
curricula.description: Interactive science lessons categorized by grade level, combining video instruction and easy-to-do physical activities.

curricula.name: The Story of the World
curricula.subject: History
curricula.favoritePart: The narrative format makes history read like a collection of stories rather than a dry textbook.
curricula.description: A chronological four-volume world history course covering ancient times through the 20th century, highly popular with classical educators.

curricula.name: Torchlight Curriculum
curricula.subject: Language Arts
curricula.favoritePart: Rich literature selections and modern, eclectic approach to science and art history.
curricula.description: A literature-heavy, secular curriculum focusing on global history, quality books, and child-led exploration.

curricula.name: CLE sunrise Mathematics
curricula.subject: Math
curricula.favoritePart: Small, digestible daily booklets ('LightUnits') give kids a sense of accomplishment.
curricula.description: A structured, highly spiral textbook/workbook system with strong review and clear focus on arithmetic skills.

curricula.name: Blossom & Root Science
curricula.subject: Science
curricula.favoritePart: Nature study modules and beautiful hands-on laboratory journals.
curricula.description: A creative, nature-focused science curriculum blending books, hands-on labs, and outdoor exploration.

fieldtrips.name: Local Science & Innovation Museum
fieldtrips.subject: Science
fieldtrips.description: Interactive exhibits covering physics, engineering, and digital arts. Discounts available for homeschool groups on Tuesdays.

fieldtrips.name: Heritage Pioneer Farm & Homestead
fieldtrips.subject: History
fieldtrips.description: Active living history farm with blacksmithing, sheep shearing, and butter-churning workshops tailored to school children.

fieldtrips.name: Discovery Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
fieldtrips.subject: Science
fieldtrips.description: Fascinating self-guided tour focusing on greenhouse biomes, native desert plants, and butterfly migrations.

fieldtrips.name: Summit University Space Observatory
fieldtrips.subject: Science
fieldtrips.description: Free public viewing nights every Friday. Professional astronomers host telescope guides for parents and older students.

businessads.description: Specialized phonics tutoring, reading assessments, and dyslexia support for homeschoolers in grades K-5.
Private music lessons with flexible daytime slots for homeschooling families. Over 10 years teaching classical piano and violin.
Weekly outdoor co-op gatherings focusing on survival skills, trail identification, and botanical studies for kids age 6-12.
Customizable physical homeschool organizers, record books, and student journals. Hand-bound and customized to your school year.
A family-owned bakery and café in the heart of downtown. Fresh sourdough bread, pastries, and artisanal coffee. 10% discount for homeschool families on co-op days.
On-site and remote IT support, computer repair, and software help for homeschooling families and small businesses.
Personalized homeschool consulting, curriculum matching, and high school transcript evaluations to help you navigate your journey with confidence.

resources.name: Khan Academy
resources.subject: All Subjects
resources.description: High-quality, self-paced video lectures and quizzes covering K-12 subjects, heavily used for math and SAT prep.

resources.name: Duolingo
resources.subject: Foreign Language
resources.description: Gamified vocabulary and speech lessons covering Spanish, French, German, Latin, and 30+ other languages.

resources.name: Crash Course (YouTube Channel)
resources.subject: History & Science
resources.description: Fast-paced, animated educational video series hosted by John and Hank Green. Excellent visual supplement for middle & high schoolers.

resources.name: Starfall Education
resources.subject: Language Arts
resources.description: Interactive phonics games and reading courses designed specifically for preschool, kindergarten, and early elementary.

resources.name: Prodigy Math Game
resources.subject: Math
resources.description: Fantasy battle game that uses curriculum-aligned math problems as active mechanics. Keeps younger students motivated to practice facts.

resources.name: SciShow Kids (YouTube Channel)
resources.subject: Science
resources.description: Fun, curiosity-driven videos explaining complex scientific questions for younger learners (grades K-3). Hosted by Jessi and Squeaks.

posts.author: Sarah Jenkins
posts.title: Welcome to the Grove Community!
posts.content: This is a warm, welcoming space for homeschooling parents to share advice, ask questions, coordinate meetups, and encourage one another. Feel free to introduce yourself!

posts.author: Michael Vance
posts.title: Co-op curriculum suggestions for 3rd grade?
posts.content: We are forming a small neighborhood co-op for science experiments next semester. Does anyone have experience using Blossom & Root in a group setting, or suggestions for open-and-go kits?

posts.author: Emily Clark
posts.title: Park Day Meetup this Friday
posts.content: Let's meet at Oak Tree Park at 1:00 PM this Friday for a casual playdate and parent chat. Kids of all ages are welcome! I'll bring some popsicles.
